The true answer 'The World of the Twenty First Century' implies a different word (likely related to 'giño' or 'gimnasia' or a specific Latin root found in 'gimlie'). By accepting 'caminata' as the search target without verification, the entire multi-agent effort was derailed into finding information for the wrong word.
